summary: Energy Company of Paraná (COPEL) filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary Copel Distribuição received approval from ANEEL for the 6th Periodic Tariff Review cycle. The review sets a net Regulatory Asset Base of R$ 19,936.2 million and an average tariff effect of 20.51%, effective June 24, 2026. This is a routine regulatory filing regarding utility rate adjustments, not a special situation. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate restructuring is involved. The filing details the components of Parcel B (return on capital, depreciation, operating costs) and Parcel A (sector charges, transmission, power purchase costs). No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
